metric_contract.weighting: Arithmetic mean per complete question, with metric-specific counts; all valid rows retained, including zeros and incorrect outcomes.
metric_contract.log_floor_rule: Replace p with max(p,epsilon) only inside logarithms; do not renormalize the floored vector. Zero-q KL terms contribute zero. NLL/KL with active floors are finite clipped diagnostics.
metric_contract.probability_normalization: Reject probability-sum errors greater than 1e-05; divide by the original sum within tolerance to correct export roundoff. Record both original sums. Brier, L2, action mass and ECE use these unfloored probabilities.
metric_contract.brier: sum_k (p[k]-one_hot(observed_Y)[k])^2; for Boolean this is twice scalar Bernoulli Brier.
metric_contract.known_q_squared_l2: sum_k (p[k]-q[k])^2 against the programmatic conditional distribution.
metric_contract.boolean_ece: 10 fixed bins of positive-class p(true) versus observed true frequency; finite sample, not top-label ECE.
metric_contract.policy_separation: Exact truth, declared maze optimal-action support, and reference action preferences are separate. Snake always uses reference_action_mass regardless of its generic target kind. Support mass is not an event-success probability; Snake local preferences are not globally optimal Snake actions.
metric_contract.tie_rule: First candidate in the saved order for argmax ties; no reconstruction of an absent action sample.
metric_contract.selection: Read-only reporting of the supplied runs; no winner selection or training changes.
metric_contract.scope: Prediction artifacts permit target/cohort consistency and state-ID overlap checks, but not an independent training/map leakage audit or verification of simulator correctness.

boolean_ece.definition: 10 fixed equal-width bins of p(true), compared with the observed true frequency; not top-label confidence ECE.
boolean_ece.interval_rule: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive, except the last bin includes 1.
boolean_ece.finite_sample_note: Observed frequencies and ECE depend on finite outcome draws and bin counts; this is not a population calibration guarantee or an independent-map confidence interval.
